label: Refund rule v2 (30 days, unused)
wordings: Approve a refund when the item reaches the seller within 30 days of delivery and has not been used.
A refund is valid only if (1) the item is back with the seller no later than 30 days after delivery and (2) it shows no signs of use.
Refund if the item is returned within 30 days of delivery and unused. Otherwise do not refund.
The buyer gets a refund when the return arrives within thirty days of the delivery date and the product is unused.

cases.text: Buyer returned an unopened item 3 days after delivery.
Buyer returned the item 12 days after delivery, unused.
Buyer returned the item 20 days after delivery, in the original box.
Buyer returned the item 31 days after delivery, unused.

Buyer returned the item 34 days after delivery because the carrier lost the first parcel.
